A '''magno-injector''' was a scientific instrument.<ref name="SS">{{JournalCite|12|Shape-shifters}}</ref> It was used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] to inject [[X0-X1]] with modified [[Evolution Droid]]s to destroy it and cut its connection to the [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] [[Computer Core]].<ref name="CCC">[[Crisis on Cloud City (adventure book)|''Crisis on Cloud City'']]</ref> A magno-injector was also used by [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] of the [[Karflo Corporation/Legends|Karflo Corporation]] to inject a [[Poison/Legends|toxin]] into [[Polydroxol]]s to kill them.<ref name="SS" />
